title: Welcome, introductions and why SEEDS
detail: Welcome and round of introductions. Everyone pins a place in the corridor that matters to them (Exercise 0).

title: The project plan: goals, deliverables and who does what
detail: Intro deck: the region, ARC goals and performance measures, the four deliverables, each partner's tasks (3 minutes per partner), the 18-month timeline.

title: Build the roadmap
detail: Sequence every task and county engagement on one wall, January 2027 to April 2028, and mark the dependencies between partners.

title: Training I: stakeholder instruments and planning metrics
detail: UAH walks through the Task 1 instruments, the pre- and post-engagement capacity assessment, sign-in and participation logs, and how answers feed the Greenbelt Corridor Planner.

title: Rehearse a county workshop
lead: UAH coaches; ACI and LTNAL facilitate
detail: In trios, ACI and LTNAL staff run a 15-minute mini-workshop end to end, including the weighting activity in the live planner.

title: Training II: STEAM engagement and participatory science
detail: Sewanee introduces the STEAM engagement strategy, student roles and the field data-collection protocol.

title: Practice the field protocol
detail: Each table records two recreation or community assets with the field form and checks the records arrive.

title: How we run the project: reporting and re-engagement
detail: Agree the reporting matrix, meeting rhythm, shared workspaces and the cycle for returning to each county.

title: Our story and media plan
detail: Draft one shared message and the media calendar for 2027.

title: Beyond 18 months: the implementation vision
detail: Write the 2030 headline for the corridor, then work back to priority project types and the funding streams to pursue.

title: Commitments and close
detail: Each partner names three actions for the next 30 days. Two-minute session evaluation (the same pre/post format we will use in counties).
